name: eve-companion
description: Table companion for the board game EVE: War for New Eden

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr server/main.ts --outDir dist-server
scripts.cloud:build: vite build --mode cloud --outDir dist-cloud && vite build --mode cloud --ssr worker/index.ts --outDir dist-worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run cloud:types --silent && tsc -p worker
